name: wporg-news-2021-project
description: The codebase and development environment for w.org/news.
author: WordPress.org

scripts.initial-setup: composer install && npm install && npm install --prefix source/wp-content/themes/wporg-news-2021 && npm run setup:mu-plugins && npm run update-configs
scripts.env:setup: wp-env start --update && npm run env:reset && npm run env:import && npm run env:misc
scripts.env:reset: wp-env clean all && wp-env run cli wp site empty --yes
scripts.start:all: npm run start & npm run sync & npm run start --prefix source/wp-content/mu-plugins/wporg-mu-plugins
